clips.title: The story
paras: Thran Khorman is the resident dwarven warrior trainer stationed in Anvilmar, nestled within the snowy Coldridge Valley. He oversees the basic combat drilling for newly minted warriors stepping out into Dun Morogh.

Standing near the training grounds of Anvilmar, Thran Khorman is tasked with turning raw dwarven recruits and visiting gnomes into disciplined combatants. He maintains a gruff, uncompromising demeanor toward anyone who lacks the grit for front-line fighting. In his eyes, even though the Third War has concluded, peace is merely an illusion: troggs encroach upon Coldridge Pass, and the mountains remain fraught with peril. He demands relentless practice with axe, mace, and shield so that Ironforge's defenders never grow dull.
